definitions.explanation: Suffix indicating regular intervals between occurrences.

examples.japanese: {一日|いちにち}おきに{薬|くすり}を{飲|の}む。
examples.english: To take medicine every other day.

notes:
EXAMPLES:
- {一日|いちにち}おき: every other day
- {二|ふた}{時間|じかん}おき: every two hours
- {三|さん}メートルおき: every three meters

Note: {一日|いちにち}おき means 'every other day' (with one day in between).
